summary: BUG: Cannot add new staff member
reported_issue: Navigating to /administration/staff, opening New Staff Member, filling valid data with a role other than Admin, and clicking Save & Close failed to add the staff member.
expected_after_fix: Staff member is added and an invitation email is sent to that member.
steps_i_followed: Clicked New Staff Member to open the dialog
Filled First Name=ZZAUTOTEST, Last Name=Regr<ts>, Email=zzautotest<ts>@shopview.com, Job Title, Salary Type=Hourly
Set Role to 'Technician' (a non-Admin role), selected a Department (required) and a Location
Clicked Save & Close and captured the create API response
actual_now: The form submitted successfully: POST /api/iam/create returned HTTP 201 with body {"data":{"message":"created","user_id":"8326277a-8f58-4368-a2d3-5ec8a388da7d"}}. The dialog closed with no validation or server errors. (Initial attempt without a Department showed the expected inline required-field validation 'Departments must have at least 1 option selected', which is correct behavior.)
notes: A staff member with a non-Admin role (Technician) is created successfully (201 created, user_id returned). Email dispatch is server-side and implied by the successful create; not independently verified. Test staff created under ZZAUTOTEST naming on disposable staging.
